raised: Page doesn't say whether the S&P 500 is bought through a provident fund for investment (קופת גמל להשקעה) or a securities account (חשבון ניירות ערך)
Nothing helps choose a specific fund, company or track, or says what they cost
Renewing money-market fund (קרן כספית מתחדשת) and makam (מק"מ) lost them; they didn't follow 'buy for less than you get back'
'After a period set by law' doesn't say how long the money is locked
Couldn't tell the difference between the comprehensive (מקיפה) and general (כללית) new pension funds
'תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים' means nothing to them
Self-managed (בניהול אישי) cards seem to be for experts; unclear what self-managed means compared with the normal version
Couldn't tell from the title whether the 'what the site doesn't cover yet' section matters to them
Screen 3 is just an empty dark strip
Didn't understand bonds (אג"ח), linked/unlinked, coupon, or interest linked to the price index
Didn't understand 'with exposure to the dollar or hedged from it', or whether that is good or bad
Didn't understand the general track (מסלול כללי) or 'not committed to a range of shares'
Didn't understand 'foreign broker' (ברוקר בחו"ל) or 'tradable market value'
No fees shown for each product per year
No rough returns, or even which products are riskier
Tax not given in numbers: how much tax is paid and how much the tax-benefit options save
No guidance on what order a 24-year-old should put spare money into the products
Doesn't say which companies offer each product or whether there is a minimum amount
Would drop the TA-35, TA-90 and TA-125 index cards
Would drop the government bond cards
Would drop the kids section and the savings plan and shekel cash cards

problems.why: The reader only says makam confused them and they would drop its cards; they never say it is wrongly listed under products when it is bought inside an account.
